references.text: The Levites were to camp around the tabernacle to protect it, just as Kohath's sons received their specific placement at the tabernacle.
Describes the camp arrangement on the south side, the same direction where Kohath's sons were to camp.
Lists the clans belonging to Kohath, the same ones who were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.
Describes the service of Kohath's sons with the holy objects in the tabernacle, explaining why they had their placement near the tabernacle.
Describes the construction of the sides of the tabernacle, including the south side (יֶרֶךְ) where Kohath's sons were to camp.
Mentions Kohath's sons in the genealogy, who are the ancestors of those who were to camp at the south side of the tabernacle.
